IIFL Holdings Limited has informed the Exchange regarding 'We are in receipt of a number of queries from investors regarding behaviour in today��s share price of IIFL Finance Limited (Formerly known as IIFL Holdings Limited). This is to inform all the stakeholders that from today, IIFL��s stock is trading after giving effect of demerger of IIFL Wealth Management Limited and IIFL Securities Limited in terms of the Composite Scheme of Arrangement. All the shareholders who bought shares till yesterday will be allotted shares of IIFL Securities Ltd and IIFL Wealth Management Ltd in about a week��s time and the said Companies will be listed at National Stock Exchange of India Limited and BSE Ltd in due course of time upon receipt of necessary approvals from Stock Exchanges and SEBI.Post listing and commencement of trading in the shares of aforesaid two entities, the aggregate value of all three listed entities put together will reflect the value of erstwhile IIFL Holdings Limited.Further, as informed earlier, the name of the Company has been changed from IIFL Holdings Limited to IIFL Finance Limited w.e.f. May 24, 2019 after giving effect to aforesaid demerger. The said change in name will reflect on the websites of BSE and NSE w.e.f. June 04, 2019.We request you to take this on record and oblige. '.
